title: Shifted Lévy's Dragon Curve and Directed Graph
summary: It is known that every point on Lévy's Dragon Curve admits a natural representation as a complex power series. We introduce a directed graph $\mathcal{G}_1$ which characterizes this representation. In this paper, we study the translation of the curve by $s=-1/2+i/2$. We identify another directed graph $\mathcal{G}_2$, that characterizes the translated curve and exhibits a revolving structure analogous to that of $\mathcal{G}_1$.
